before.title: shark finning
before.content: shark finning：割鯊魚身，割取鯊魚。

after.content: 割鰭棄身：割取鯊魚的魚鰭，再把其餘身體丟回海中；不是一般在整隻鯊魚上岸後才去除魚鰭的處理。

patches.reason: Correct the concrete fin/body distinction using the directly read NOAA glossary; preserve the raw printed source transcription.

before.title: weather 與 climate
before.content: climate 指某個地區的氣候，是可數名詞，可加冠詞 a 或用複數；weather 泛指天氣，是不可數名詞，絕對不可加冠詞 a 或用複數。

after.content: climate 指某地長期的氣候，可指一種地區氣候（可數），也可概括使用（不可數）。weather 泛指某時某地的天氣，日常通常不可數，不說 a weather；但固定用語 in all weathers 等可用複數，不能一概說絕對沒有複數。

patches.reason: Retain the useful climate/weather distinction without absolute countability rules contradicted by direct dictionary variable-noun and in-all-weathers evidence.

after.content: 10 分鐘的步行路程；步行約 10 分鐘可到的距離。

patches.reason: Restore the explicit ten in the existing a ten-minute walk title instead of leaving only 分鐘.

before.title: an automated teller machine
before.content: 詞族／相關：cash、teller、an automated teller machine、a cash register

after.content: an automated teller machine（ATM）：自動提款機。相關詞：cash（現金）、teller（銀行櫃員）、a cash register（收銀機）。

patches.reason: Supply the actual term translation while preserving the whole related-word list.
patches.evidence: Existing related-term list and standard expansion of ATM; this is a reviewer translation, not a new textbook quotation.

before.title: a cash register
before.content: 詞族／相關：cash、teller、an automated teller machine、a cash register

after.content: a cash register：收銀機。相關詞：cash（現金）、teller（銀行櫃員）、an automated teller machine（自動提款機）。

patches.reason: Supply the actual title translation while preserving the related-word list.
patches.evidence: Existing related-term list; reviewer Chinese translation, not a new textbook quotation.

before.title: run into...（撞上人／物）
before.content: 撞上……。書頁「run into... 與……不期而遇；撞上……」的後半義。既有列 126 只涵蓋「偶遇」義

after.content: 撞上某人或物；與 run into sb 表示「偶然遇見某人」的另一用法區分。

patches.reason: Keep the collision meaning and remove the internal row-number explanation from the learner note.

before.title: sink or swim
before.content: sink or swim：自生自滅，載浮載沉。

after.content: 字面是沉下去或游起來；慣用語表示只能靠自己努力成功，否則就失敗，常譯「自生自滅」或「載浮載沉」。

patches.reason: Retain both inherited Chinese renderings while explaining the actual idiom rather than only literal buoyancy.

after.content: 靠運氣；碰巧。若原句另有 only，才把「只因運氣好」的限制一併譯出。

patches.reason: Distinguish luck from an extra only; preserve the original printed construction and independent practice.
